title: Anthropic's $35B cloud deal with Lambda adds new layer to circular financing concerns
title_zh: Anthropic 与 Lambda 达成的 350 亿美元云协议为循环融资担忧增添了新的一层
summary: Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) has signed a $35 billion cloud deal with Lambda (LAMD.PVT), according to Wall Street Journal reporting. Lambda is backed by Nvidia (NVDA).
summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 已与 Lambda (LAMD.PVT) 签署了价值 350 亿美元的云协议。 Lambda 由 Nvidia (NVDA) 支持。

title: Fervo Energy signs record 396 MW geothermal deal with Google
title_zh: Fervo Energy 与谷歌签署创纪录的 396 兆瓦地热协议
summary: The agreement, described as the largest enhanced geothermal power purchase deal on record, includes an option for Google to expand its offtake to nearly 1 GW
summary_zh: 该协议被称为有记录以来最大的增强型地热发电采购协议，其中包括谷歌将其发电量扩大到近 1 吉瓦的选项

title: FRVO Stock Soars Pre-Market After Largest Ever Deal With Google – A Look At The Key Highlights
title_zh: 与谷歌达成有史以来最大一笔交易后，FRVO 股票盘前飙升——主要亮点一览
summary: Google is set to purchase 396 megawatts of electricity from Fervo’s Cape Station project in southwestern Utah.
summary_zh: 谷歌计划从犹他州西南部 Fervo 的 Cape Station 项目购买 396 兆瓦的电力。

title: Fervo Energy Stock Soars as Bill Gates-Backed Company Scores Deal With Google
title_zh: 随着比尔·盖茨支持的公司与谷歌达成交易，Fervo Energy 股价飙升
summary: Fervo Energy stock soars after The Wall Street Journal reports Bill Gates-backed geothermal energy Fervo has signed a major deal with Google.
summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》报道比尔·盖茨支持的地热能源 Fervo 已与谷歌签署重大协议后，Fervo Energy 股价飙升。
